mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing immediate equity sell-offs as real rates rise and risk premiums expand over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates robust labor market and consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion with unemployment below 4.0%, a sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic growth supporting corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth persists for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, driving corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200,000 units annually, it signals weakening consumer confidence and housing market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals monetary tightening during strong labor market, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion with RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as earnings growth stalls.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with high consumer spending
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS > 700000 and GDPC1 growth declines for two consecutive quarters.
